parameters.query:
SELECT 
  c.*,
  u.telegram_username as recruiter
FROM candidates c
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT telegram_user_id, telegram_username 
  FROM candidates
) u ON c.telegram_user_id = u.telegram_user_id
WHERE DATE(c.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow') = CURRENT_DATE
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
